title.zh: 卷三 宋本紀下第三 明帝 後廢帝 順帝
title.en: Volume 3 Liu Song Annals 3: Emperor Ming, Later Deposed Emperor, Emperor Shun
title.raw: 卷三 宋本紀下第三 明帝 後廢帝 順帝 Volume 3 Liu Song Annals 3: Emperor Ming, Later Deposed Emperor, Emperor Shun

sentences.zh: 宋本紀下第三

translations.literal: Liu Song Annals, lower scroll, third.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Song Annals, Part Three.

sentences.zh: 太宗明皇帝諱彧，字休景，小字榮期，文帝第十一子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of the Taizong lineage, taboo name Yu, style name Xiujing, childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of the Taizong line, whose taboo name was Yu, style name Xiujing, and childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十六年十月生。

translations.literal: He was born in the tenth month of the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the tenth month of the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，封淮陽王，二十九年改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang; in the twenty-ninth year his fief was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang, and in the twenty-ninth year his title was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 孝武踐阼，累遷鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu ascended the throne, he was repeatedly promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, he rose through successive posts to General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲入朝，時廢帝疑畏諸父，以上付廷尉，明日將加禍害，上乃與腹心阮佃夫、李道兒等密謀。

translations.literal: That year he entered court; at the time the Deposed Emperor was suspicious and fearful of his uncles, and had him handed over to the Minister of Justice. The next day he was about to be harmed, and the prince then secretly plotted with his confidants Ruan Tianfu and Li Dao'er.
translations.idiomatic: That year he came to court. The Deposed Emperor, suspicious and fearful of his uncles, had him handed over to the Minister of Justice and planned to kill him the next day. The prince then secretly plotted with his confidants Ruan Tianfu and Li Dao'er.

sentences.zh: 時廢帝左右直合將軍宗越、譚金、童太一等是夜並外宿，佃夫、道兒因結壽寂之等，十一月二十九日，弑廢帝於後堂。

translations.literal: At that time the Deposed Emperor's attendants, the Direct Attendant General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi, all lodged outside that night. Tianfu and Dao'er therefore joined with Shou Jizhi and others; on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month they assassinated the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor's personal guards—Direct Attendant General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi—were all lodging outside that night. Tianfu and Dao'er joined with Shou Jizhi and others, and on the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month they assassinated the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 建安王休仁便稱臣，奉引升西堂，登御坐。

translations.literal: Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren at once declared himself a subject and, supporting and leading him, escorted him up to the Western Hall and onto the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren immediately declared himself a subject, escorted him to the Western Hall, and seated him on the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 事出倉卒，上失履，跣，猶著烏紗帽，休仁呼主衣以白紗代之。

translations.literal: The affair arose in sudden haste; the prince lost his shoes and went barefoot, yet still wore a black gauze cap. Xiu Ren called for the master of robes to replace it with white gauze.
translations.idiomatic: The coup came in sudden haste. The prince lost his shoes and stood barefoot, still wearing a black gauze cap, until Xiu Ren had the master of robes bring white gauze to replace it.

sentences.zh: 未即位，凡眾事悉稱令書。

translations.literal: Before he had yet taken the throne, all public affairs were uniformly styled as orders.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had formally ascended the throne, all official business was issued as written orders.

sentences.zh: 己未，司徒豫章王子尚、山陰公主並賜死，宗越、譚金、童太一伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Prince of Yuzhang Zi Shang and the Princess of Shanyin were both granted death; Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, Prince of Yuzhang Zi Shang and the Princess of Shanyin were both put to death, and Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi were executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申朔，令書以東海王褘為中書監、太尉，以晉安王子勳為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, gengshen, an order appointed Prince of Donghai Hui as Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commandant, and Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu as General of Chariots and Cavalry with the privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the first day of the twelfth month, an order appointed Prince of Donghai Hui as Director of the Masters of Writing and Grand Commandant, and Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu as General of Chariots and Cavalry with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以建安王休仁為司徒、尚書令、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was made Minister of Works, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was appointed Minister of Works, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改封安陸王子綏為江夏王。

translations.literal: On yichou, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 江州刺史晉安王子勳舉兵反，鎮軍長史鄧琬為其謀主，雍州刺史袁顗赴之。

translations.literal: The Governor of Jiang Province, Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, raised troops in rebellion; the Chief Administrator of the Pacifying Army, Deng Wan, was his chief strategist, and the Governor of Yong Province, Yuan Yi, went to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, Governor of Jiang Province, raised troops in rebellion. Deng Wan, Chief Administrator of the Pacifying Army, was his chief strategist, and Yuan Yi, Governor of Yong Province, joined him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，謁太廟。

translations.literal: On rewu he paid visit to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On rewu he visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，郢州刺史安陸王子綏、會稽太守尋陽王子房、臨海王子頊並舉兵同逆。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Inspector of Ying Province, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui; the Administrator of Kuaiji, Prince of Xunyang Zi Fang; and Prince of Linhai Zi Xu all raised troops in common rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui, Inspector of Ying Province; Prince of Xunyang Zi Fang, Administrator of Kuaiji; and Prince of Linhai Zi Xu all rose in rebellion together.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙未，晉安王子勳僭即偽位於尋陽，年號義嘉。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on yimwei, Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu presumptuously assumed the false throne at Xunyang, with era name Yijia.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on yimwei in the first month, Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu presumptuously declared himself emperor at Xunyang, taking the era name Yijia.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，徐州刺史薛安都舉兵反。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Inspector of Xu Province, Xue An'du, raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xue An'du, Inspector of Xu Province, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 甲午，內外戒嚴，司徒建安王休仁都督諸軍南討。

translations.literal: On jiawu, court and camp were placed under martial alert; Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was made overall commander of the armies for the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu martial law was declared within and without the court, and Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was appointed overall commander of the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 丙申，徐州刺史申令孫、司州刺史龐孟虯、豫州刺史殷琰、青州刺史沈文秀、冀州刺史崔道固、湘州行事何慧文、廣州刺史袁曇遠、益州刺史蕭惠開、梁州刺史柳元怙並同逆。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Inspector of Xu Province Shen Ling-sun, the Inspector of Si Province Pang Mengjiao, the Inspector of Yu Province Yin Yan, the Inspector of Qing Province Shen Wenxiu, the Inspector of Ji Province Cui Daogu, the acting Governor of Xiang Province He Huiwen, the Inspector of Guang Province Yuan Tanyuan, the Inspector of Yi Province Xiao Huikai, and the Inspector of Liang Province Liu Yuanku all rebelled together.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Shen Ling-sun of Xu Province, Pang Mengjiao of Si Province, Yin Yan of Yu Province, Shen Wenxiu of Qing Province, Cui Daogu of Ji Province, He Huiwen acting for Xiang Province, Yuan Tanyuan of Guang Province, Xiao Huikai of Yi Province, and Liu Yuanku of Liang Province all joined the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕親禦六軍，頓中興堂。

translations.literal: On bingwu the imperial carriage personally commanded the Six Armies and halted at the Hall of Central Revival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the emperor personally took command of the Six Armies and encamped at the Hall of Central Revival.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，南豫州刺史山陽王休佑改為豫州刺史，西討。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Prince of Shanyang Xiu You was changed to Inspector of Yu Province and marched west on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Prince of Shanyang Xiu You was reassigned as Inspector of Yu Province and marched west on campaign.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守顧琛、吳興太守王曇生、義興太守劉延熙、晉陵太守袁標、山陽太守程天祚並舉兵反。

translations.literal: The Administrator of Wu Commandery Gu Chen, the Administrator of Wuxing Wang Tansheng, the Administrator of Yixing Liu Yanxi, the Administrator of Jinling Yuan Biao, and the Administrator of Shanyang Cheng Tianzuo all raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Chen, Administrator of Wu Commandery; Wang Tansheng, Administrator of Wuxing; Liu Yanxi, Administrator of Yixing; Yuan Biao, Administrator of Jinling; and Cheng Tianzuo, Administrator of Shanyang, all rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鎮東將軍巴陵王休若統軍東討。

translations.literal: Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo, General Who Pacifies the East, commanded the army on the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo, General Who Pacifies the East, took command of the eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 壬子，崇憲皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On renzi the Empress Dowager Chongxian died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Empress Dowager Chongxian died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，以蔡興宗為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yichou, Cai Xingzong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou, Cai Xingzong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，吳興太守張永、右軍將軍蕭道成東討，平晉陵。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Yong and the General of the Right Army Xiao Daocheng marched east on campaign and pacified Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Yong, Administrator of Wuxing, and Xiao Daocheng, General of the Right Army, marched east and pacified Jinling.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，建武將軍吳喜公率諸軍破賊于吳、吳興、會稽，平定三郡，同逆皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the General Who Establishes Martial Prowess Wu Xi publicly led the armies and defeated the rebels in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacifying the three commanderies; all who had rebelled together were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wu Xi, General Who Establishes Martial Prowess, led the armies to victory in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacifying all three commanderies. Every co-conspirator was executed.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍蕭道成前鋒北討，輔國將軍劉勉前鋒西討。

translations.literal: The General Who Assists the State Xiao Daocheng served as vanguard on the northern campaign; the General Who Assists the State Liu Mian served as vanguard on the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng, General Who Assists the State, led the northern vanguard; Liu Mian, General Who Assists the State, led the western vanguard.

sentences.zh: 劉胡眾四萬據赭圻。

translations.literal: Liu Hu's host of forty thousand held Zheqi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hu held Zheqi with a force of forty thousand.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻，死之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, the General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zheqi and died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, Yin Xiaozu, General Who Pacifies the Army, attacked Zheqi and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒。

translations.literal: The General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was appointed in his stead as vanguard of the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Youzhi, General Who Assists the State, replaced him as vanguard of the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 賊眾稍盛，袁顗頓鵲尾，連營至濃湖，眾十餘萬。

translations.literal: The rebel forces gradually grew stronger; Yuan Yi encamped at Quewei, with linked camps extending to Nonghu, numbering more than one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel strength grew steadily. Yuan Yi encamped at Quewei, his linked camps stretching to Nonghu with more than one hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 丙申，南徐州刺史桂陽王休范總統北討諸軍事。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan was made overall commander of the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan was appointed overall commander of the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶尋陽王子房爵為松滋縣侯。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Prince of Xunyang Zi Fang was degraded in rank to Marquis of Songzi County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince of Xunyang Zi Fang was stripped of his princely title and reduced to Marquis of Songzi County.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，令人入米七百石者除郡，減此各有差。

translations.literal: On guimao, it was ordered that whoever contributed seven hundred shi of grain would be appointed to a commandery governorship, with reductions from that standard granting lesser appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao it was decreed that anyone who contributed seven hundred shi of grain would receive appointment as a commandery governor, with lower amounts qualifying for lesser posts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，斷新錢，專用古錢。

translations.literal: On renzi, new coinage was abolished and only old coin was to be used.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi new coinage was abolished and only old coin permitted.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲寅，葬崇憲皇太后于修甯陵。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on jiayin, the Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at Xiuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on jiayin, the Empress Dowager Chongxian was interred at Xiuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，以仇池太守楊僧嗣為北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingyou, Yang Sengsi, Administrator of Qiuchi, was made Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingyou, Yang Sengsi, Administrator of Qiuchi, was appointed Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，司徒建安王休仁率眾軍大破賊，斬偽尚書僕射袁顗，進討江、郢、荊、湘、雍五州，平之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao, the Minister of Works Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren led the mass of armies to a great defeat of the rebels, beheaded the false Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Yi, and pressed the campaign through the five provinces of Jiang, Ying, Jing, Xiang, and Yong, pacifying them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren, Minister of Works, led the main armies to a crushing victory, beheaded the rebel Vice Director Yuan Yi, and carried the campaign through Jiang, Ying, Jing, Xiang, and Yong provinces until all were pacified.

sentences.zh: 晉安王子勳、安陸王子綏、臨海王子頊、邵陵王子元並賜死，同黨皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui, Prince of Linhai Zi Xu, and Prince of Shaoling Zi Yuan were all granted death; all their fellow conspirators were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin'an Zi Xu, Prince of An'lu Zi Sui, Prince of Linhai Zi Xu, and Prince of Shaoling Zi Yuan were all put to death, along with every co-conspirator.

sentences.zh: 諸將帥封賞各有差。

translations.literal: The various generals received enfeoffments and rewards according to their respective merits.
translations.idiomatic: The commanders received titles and rewards according to their respective merits.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，六軍解嚴。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi, the Six Armies stood down from martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, the Six Armies were stood down from martial alert.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以王玄謨為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，領護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Wang Xuamo was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness on the Left with the privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, and concurrently Colonel Director of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wang Xuamo was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness on the Left with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, and concurrently Colonel Director of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，永嘉王子仁、始安王子真、淮南王子孟、南平王子產、廬陵王子輿、松滋侯子房並賜死。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yimao, Prince of Yongjia Zi Ren, Prince of Shi'an Zi Zhen, Prince of Huainan Zi Meng, Prince of Nanping Zi Chan, Prince of Luling Zi Yu, and Marquis of Songzi Zi Fang were all granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on yimao, Prince of Yongjia Zi Ren, Prince of Shi'an Zi Zhen, Prince of Huainan Zi Meng, Prince of Nanping Zi Chan, Prince of Luling Zi Yu, and Marquis of Songzi Zi Fang were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以沈攸之為中領軍，與張永俱北討。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Shen Youzhi was made Colonel Director of the Interior and marched north on campaign together with Zhang Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Shen Youzhi was appointed Colonel Director of the Interior and marched north with Zhang Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立皇子昱為皇太子。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the prince's son Yu was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the prince Yu was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，立建平王景素子延年為新安王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Yan Nian, son of Prince of Jianping Jing Su, was established as Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Yan Nian, son of Prince of Jianping Jing Su, was established as Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 十二月，薛安都要引魏軍，張永、沈攸之大敗，於是遂失淮北四州及豫州淮西地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Xue An'du sought to bring in Northern Wei armies; Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi suffered a great defeat, and thereby the four northern provinces of Huai and the lands west of the Huai in Yu Province were lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xue An'du invited Northern Wei forces into the field. Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi were routed, and the four Huai provinces plus the lands west of the Huai in Yu Province were lost.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏天安元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Northern Wei's Tian'an era.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of the Northern Wei Tian'an era.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，以農役將興，詔太官停宰牛。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on gengzi, because agricultural labor was about to begin, an edict ordered the Imperial Kitchen to cease slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on gengzi in the first month, with farm labor about to begin, an edict ordered the Imperial Kitchen to stop slaughtering cattle.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，曲赦豫、南豫二州。

translations.literal: On guimao, a partial amnesty was granted in Yu and Southern Yu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao a partial amnesty was granted in Yu and Southern Yu provinces.

sentences.zh: 閏正月庚午，都下大雨雪，遣使巡行，振貸各有差。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month, on gengwu, the capital was struck by heavy rain and snow; envoys were dispatched on inspection tours, with relief and loans granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month, on gengwu, heavy rain and snow struck the capital. Envoys were sent on inspection tours to grant relief and loans according to need.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，為戰亡將士舉哀。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiashen, mourning was observed for officers and soldiers who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, mourning rites were held for officers and soldiers fallen in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曲赦青、冀二州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, a partial amnesty was granted in Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen a partial amnesty was granted in Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，詔以故丞相江夏文獻王、故太尉巴東忠烈公柳元景、故司空始興襄公沈慶之、故征西將軍洮陽肅侯宗愨陪祭孝武廟庭。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingxu, an edict ordered that the late Chancellor, the Literary and Illustrious Prince of Jiangxia; the late Grand Commandant, the Loyal and Valiant Duke of Badong Liu Yuanjing; the late Minister of Works, the Marquis of Xiang of Shixing Shen Qingzhi; and the late General Who Conquers the West, the Solemn Marquis of Yaoyang Zong Que, should join in sacrifice at the temple hall of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on bingxu, an edict ordered the late Literary and Illustrious Prince of Jiangxia, the late Loyal and Valiant Duke of Badong Liu Yuanjing, the late Marquis of Xiang of Shixing Shen Qingzhi, and the late Solemn Marquis of Yaoyang Zong Que to receive joint sacrifice at Emperor Xiaowu's temple hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，立桂陽王休範第二子德嗣為廬陵王，立侍中劉韞第二子銑為南豐王，以奉廬江昭王、南豐哀王祀。

translations.literal: On gengzi, De Si, second son of Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, was established as Prince of Luling; Xian, second son of Palace Attendant Liu Yun, was established as Prince of Nanfeng, to continue the sacrifices of the Illustrious Prince of Lujiang and the Lamented Prince of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi De Si, second son of Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, was established as Prince of Luling, and Xian, second son of Palace Attendant Liu Yun, as Prince of Nanfeng, to maintain the ancestral lines of the Illustrious Prince of Lujiang and the Lamented Prince of Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，詔宣太后崇甯陵禁內墳瘞遷徙者給葬直，蠲復其家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingchen, an edict ordered that within the forbidden precinct of the Empress Dowager Xuan's Chongning Mausoleum, anyone whose family tombs within the inner enclosure had been relocated would receive burial expenses, and their households would be exempted from corvée and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen, an edict granted burial expenses to families whose tombs within the inner precinct of Empress Dowager Xuan's Chongning Mausoleum had been relocated, and exempted those households from corvée and taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以太子詹事袁粲為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On renxu, Yuan Can, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Yuan Can, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬寅，以中領軍沈攸之行南兗州刺史，率眾北伐。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on renyin, Shen Youzhi, Colonel Director of the Interior, acted as Inspector of Southern Yan Province and led the armies on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on renyin, Shen Youzhi, Colonel Director of the Interior, took office as Inspector of Southern Yan Province and led the armies north.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，以皇后六宮以下雜衣千領、金釵千枚，賜北伐將士。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu, a thousand sets of miscellaneous garments from the empress and the Six Palaces downward, and a thousand gold hairpins, were bestowed on the northern campaign soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, a thousand sets of garments from the empress and the Six Palaces, and a thousand gold hairpins, were bestowed on soldiers of the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，改封新安王延年為始平王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renwu, Prince of Xin'an Yan Nian was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on renwu Prince of Xin'an Yan Nian was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鎮西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅為征西大將軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Tuyuhun Shiyin, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He provinces, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Tuyuhun Shiyin, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He provinces, was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立建安王休仁第二子伯猷為江夏王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Bo You, second son of Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren, was established as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Bo You, second son of Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren, was established as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏皇興元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Northern Wei's Huangxing era.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of the Northern Wei Huangxing era.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙辰朔，雨草于宮。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the fourth year, on bingchen, the first day, grass rained down in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on bingchen, the first day of the first month, grass rained down inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，零陵王司馬勖薨。

translations.literal: On yihai, Sima Xu, Chief Administrator of the Princedom of Lingling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Sima Xu, Chief Administrator of the Princedom of Lingling, died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yisi, Wang Xuamo, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness on the Left with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Wang Xuamo, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness on the Left with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, died.

sentences.zh: 三月，交州人李長仁據州叛。

translations.literal: In the third month, Li Changren of Jiao Province seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Changren of Jiao Province seized the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 祅賊攻廣州，殺刺史羊希，龍驤將軍陳伯紹討平之。

translations.literal: Demonic rebels attacked Guang Province, killed the Inspector Yang Xi, and were suppressed by the General of Agile Cavalry Chen Bozhao.
translations.idiomatic: Demonic rebels attacked Guang Province, killed Inspector Yang Xi, and were suppressed by Chen Bozhao, General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，改封東海王褘為廬江王，山陽王休佑為晉平王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, Prince of Donghai Hui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang, and Prince of Shanyang Xiu You as Prince of Jinping.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, Prince of Donghai Hui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang and Prince of Shanyang Xiu You as Prince of Jinping.

sentences.zh: 秋九月戊辰，詔定黥刖之制。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on wuchen, an edict fixed the regulations for tattooing and amputation.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the ninth month, on wuchen, an edict fixed the regulations for tattooing and amputation.

sentences.zh: 有司奏：「自今凡劫竊執官仗、拒戰邏司、攻剽亭寺及傷害吏人，並監司將吏自為劫，皆不限人數，悉依舊制斬刑。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "From now on, all who in robbery seize official weapons, resist patrol officers in battle, raid postal stations and monasteries, or harm officials and commoners—and also supervising officials and officers who themselves commit robbery—regardless of number, shall all be subject to decapitation under the old statute.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices memorialized: "Henceforth, anyone who in robbery seizes official weapons, fights patrol officers, raids postal stations and monasteries, or harms officials and commoners—and any supervising official or officer who commits robbery himself—regardless of numbers involved, shall be decapitated under the old statute.

sentences.zh: 若遇赦，黥及兩頰 '劫'字，斷去兩腳筋，徙付交、梁、寧州。

translations.literal: If an amnesty is encountered, tattoo the character for "robbery" on both cheeks, sever the tendons of both legs, and exile to Jiao, Liang, or Ning provinces.
translations.idiomatic: If an amnesty intervenes, tattoo the character for "robbery" on both cheeks, sever the tendons of both legs, and exile to Jiao, Liang, or Ning provinces.

sentences.zh: 五人以下止相逼奪者，亦依黥作'劫'字，斷去兩腳筋，徙付遠州。

translations.literal: Those of five persons or fewer who merely coerce and seize property shall likewise be tattooed with the character for "robbery," have the tendons of both legs severed, and be exiled to distant provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Groups of five or fewer who merely coerce and seize property shall likewise be tattooed with "robbery," have both leg tendons severed, and be exiled to distant provinces.

sentences.zh: 若遇赦，原斷徒猶黥面，依舊補冶士。

translations.literal: If an amnesty is encountered, those originally sentenced to exile shall still be tattooed on the face and, as before, assigned as artisan laborers.
translations.idiomatic: If an amnesty intervenes, those originally sentenced to exile shall still be tattooed on the face and, as before, assigned as artisan laborers.

sentences.zh: 家口應及坐，悉依舊結謫。

translations.literal: Household members who ought to be implicated shall all be banished under the old rules of collective punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Household members liable for collective punishment shall all be banished under the old rules.

sentences.zh: 」及上崩，其例乃寢。

translations.literal: " When the sovereign died, this precedent was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: " When the emperor died, this precedent was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上備法駕幸東宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu the sovereign, with full imperial equipage, visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor, with full imperial escort, visited the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之，發諸州兵北伐。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guiyou, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun; troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on guiyou, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred, and troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，親耕藉田。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the fifth year, on guihai, he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on guihai in the first month, he personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，魏克青州，執刺史沈文秀以歸。

translations.literal: On yichou, Northern Wei captured Qing Province and took the Inspector Shen Wenxiu back with them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Northern Wei captured Qing Province and took Inspector Shen Wenxiu captive.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以廬江王褘為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingshen, Prince of Lujiang Hui was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies and Inspector of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen, Prince of Lujiang Hui was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies and Inspector of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛未，立晉平王休佑子宣曜為南平王。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, on xinwei, Xuan Yao, son of Prince of Jinping Xiu You, was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth month, on xinwei Xuan Yao, son of Prince of Jinping Xiu You, was established as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，改輔國將軍為輔師將軍。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on renxu, the title General Who Assists the State was changed to General Who Assists the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on renxu the title General Who Assists the State was changed to General Who Assists the Army.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，立長沙王纂子延之為始平王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, Yan Zhi, son of Prince of Changsha Zuan, was established as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin Yan Zhi, son of Prince of Changsha Zuan, was established as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，分荊、益之五郡置三巴校尉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, five commanderies of Jing and Yi provinces were separated off to establish the Colonel of the Three Ba.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen, five commanderies of Jing and Yi provinces were separated to establish the Colonel of the Three Ba.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙亥，初制間二年一祭南郊，間一年一祭明堂。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the sixth year, on yihai, it was first decreed that the southern suburban sacrifice would be offered every second year and the Bright Hall sacrifice every other year.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on yihai in the first month, it was first decreed that sacrifices at the southern suburb would be offered every second year and at the Bright Hall in alternate years.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，立皇子燮為晉熙王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guihai, the prince's son Xie was established as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on guihai the prince's son Xie was established as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，以王景文為尚書左僕射、揚州刺史，以袁粲為右僕射。

translations.literal: On jimao, Wang Jingwen was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province; Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wang Jingwen was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, and Yuan Can as Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 己未，改臨賀郡為臨慶郡。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Linhe Commandery was renamed Linqing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Linhe Commandery was renamed Linqing Commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，臨慶王智井薨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingxu, Prince of Linqing Zhi Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingxu Prince of Linqing Zhi Jing died.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，立總明觀，征學士以充之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuyin, the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars were recruited to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuyin the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars recruited to staff it.

sentences.zh: 置東觀祭酒、訪舉各一人，舉士二十人，分為儒、道、文、史、陰陽五部學，言陰陽者遂無其人。

translations.literal: A Director of the Eastern Pavilion, a Visitor and Recommender, and twenty scholars were appointed; they were divided into five departments of Confucian, Daoist, literary, historical, and yin-yang learning—but for yin-yang learning there was ultimately no one.
translations.idiomatic: A Director of the Eastern Pavilion, a Visitor and Recommender, and twenty scholars were appointed and divided into five departments—Confucian, Daoist, literary, historical, and yin-yang—but no one could be found for yin-yang studies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，立皇子贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinmao, the prince's son Zan was established as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on xinmao the prince's son Zan was established as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以邊難未息，制父母隔在異域者，悉使婚宦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi, because border troubles had not yet ceased, it was decreed that those whose parents were separated in foreign lands should all be permitted to marry and take office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi, because border troubles continued, it was decreed that those whose parents were stranded in foreign lands should be permitted to marry and take office.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，置散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the seventh year, on jiaxu, the office of Memorial-Presenting Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant was established.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on jiaxu in the first month, the office of Memorial-Presenting Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant was established.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinyou, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊午，鴆司徒建安王休仁。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on wuwu, Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was poisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, on wuwu, Prince Jian'an Xiu Ren was poisoned to death.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以袁粲為尚書令，褚彥回為右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and Chu Yanhui Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and Chu Yanhui as Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，追免晉平王休佑為庶人。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince of Jinping Xiu You was posthumously stripped and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Prince of Jinping Xiu You was posthumously stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，罷散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, the office of Memorial-Presenting Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, the office of Memorial-Presenting Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，江州刺史巴陵王休若賜死。

translations.literal: On yichou, Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo, Governor of Jiang Province, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince of Baling Xiu Ruo, Governor of Jiang Province, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以皇子躋繼江夏文獻王義恭。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the prince's son Ji succeeded to the line of the Literary and Illustrious Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the prince's son Ji succeeded to the line of the Literary and Illustrious Prince of Jiangxia, Yigong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝疾間。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the sovereign's illness eased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor's illness eased.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立皇子准為安成王。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the prince's son Zhun was established as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the prince's son Zhun was established as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏孝文帝延興元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Northern Wei Emperor Xiaowen's Yanxing era.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of the Northern Wei Yanxing era under Emperor Xiaowen.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年春正月甲寅朔，上以疾未痊，故改元。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Taiyu, on jiayin, the first day, because the sovereign's illness had not yet healed, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first Taiyu year, on jiayin, the first day, because the emperor had not yet recovered, the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，巨人跡見西池冰上。

translations.literal: On dingsi, giant footprints appeared on the ice of the Western Pond.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi giant footprints appeared on the ice of the Western Pond.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，上疾大漸。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jihai, the sovereign's illness grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jihai, the emperor's illness grew critical.

sentences.zh: 加江州刺史桂陽王休范位司空，以劉勉為尚書右僕射，蔡興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，郢州刺史沈攸之進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Liu Mian was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Cai Xingzong was made General Who Conquers the West with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies and Governor of Jing Province; and Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Ying Province, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, Governor of Jiang Province, was promoted to Minister of Works; Liu Mian was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Cai Xingzong was made General Who Conquers the West with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies and Governor of Jing Province; and Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Ying Province, was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 袁粲、褚彥回、劉勉、蔡興宗、沈攸之入合被顧命。

translations.literal: Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi entered the privy chamber and received the dying charge.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, Chu Yanhui, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were summoned to the privy chamber and entrusted with the dying charge.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩于景福殿，時年三十四。

translations.literal: That day, the sovereign died in the Hall of Auspicious Blessings, aged thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor died in the Hall of Auspicious Blessings, aged thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，葬臨沂縣莫府山高寧陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin, he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mofu Mountain in Linyi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mofu Mountain in Linyi County.

sentences.zh: 帝好讀書，愛文義，在藩時撰江左以來文章志，又續衛瓘所注論語二卷。

translations.literal: The emperor loved reading and cherished literary principles; while still in his princedom he compiled a record of writings from the lands east of the Yangzi since the Jin, and also continued Wei Guan's annotated Lunyu in two scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor loved reading and valued literary culture. While still a prince he compiled a record of writings from the lands east of the Yangzi since the Jin, and continued Wei Guan's annotated Lunyu in two scrolls.

sentences.zh: 及即大位，舊臣才學之士多蒙引進。

translations.literal: When he reached the great throne, many old ministers and men of learning were favored and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned, he favored and promoted many veteran ministers and learned men.

sentences.zh: 末年好鬼神，多忌諱，言語文書有禍敗凶喪疑似之言應回避者，犯即加戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he favored spirits and ghosts and was full of taboos; in speech and documents, any word suggesting disaster, defeat, mourning, or death that ought to be avoided—if violated, execution followed at once.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he grew obsessed with spirits and taboos. Any word in speech or documents suggesting disaster, defeat, or death that ought to be avoided would, if uttered, bring immediate execution.

sentences.zh: 改「騧」馬字為「馬」邊「瓜」，以「騧」字似「禍」故也。

translations.literal: He changed the character for "piebald horse" to "horse" beside "melon," because the character for "piebald horse" resembled the character for "disaster."
translations.idiomatic: He changed the character for "piebald horse" to "horse" beside "melon," because the original character resembled the character for "disaster."

sentences.zh: 嘗以南苑借張永，云：「且給三百年，期盡更請。

translations.literal: He once lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying: "I shall lend it for three hundred years; when the term expires you may ask again.
translations.idiomatic: He once lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, "I shall lend it for three hundred years; when the term expires you may ask again.

sentences.zh: 」宣陽門謂之白門，上以白門不祥，諱之。

translations.literal: " The Xuanyang Gate was called the White Gate; the sovereign considered "white gate" inauspicious and tabooed it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Xuanyang Gate was called the White Gate; the emperor considered "white gate" inauspicious and forbade the name.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞江謐嘗誤犯，上變色曰：「白汝家門！

translations.literal: Jiang Mi, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, once accidentally violated the taboo; the sovereign changed color and said: "White upon your family's gate!
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Mi, Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, once accidentally violated the taboo. The emperor flushed and said, "May whiteness fall upon your family's gate!

sentences.zh: 」路太后停屍漆床移出東宮，上幸宮見之，怒，免中庶子，以之坐死者數十人。

translations.literal: " When Empress Dowager Lu's corpse was moved out of the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the sovereign visited the palace, saw it, grew angry, dismissed the Palace Mentor, and several dozen men were put to death on that account.
translations.idiomatic: " When Empress Dowager Lu's corpse was moved out of the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the emperor visited the palace, saw it, flew into a rage, dismissed the Palace Mentor, and several dozen men were put to death on that account.

sentences.zh: 內外常慮犯觸，人不自保。

translations.literal: Within and without, people constantly feared giving offense and could not protect themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without the court, everyone lived in constant fear of giving offense and could not protect themselves.

sentences.zh: 移床修壁，先祭土神，使文士為祝策，如大祭饗。

translations.literal: When moving beds or repairing walls, they first sacrificed to the earth god and had literary men compose prayer texts, as at a great sacrificial feast.
translations.idiomatic: Before moving beds or repairing walls, they first sacrificed to the earth god and had literary men compose prayer texts as at a great sacrificial feast.

sentences.zh: 阮佃夫、楊運長、王道隆皆擅威權，言為詔敕，郡守令長一缺十除，內外混然，官以賄命，王、阮家富於公室。

translations.literal: Ruan Tianfu, Yang Yunchang, and Wang Daolong all monopolized authority; their words served as edicts and orders. When a commandery governor or district magistrate fell vacant, ten appointments might be made for one post; within and without were chaotic alike, offices were obtained by bribes, and the Wang and Ruan families were richer than the public treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Tianfu, Yang Yunchang, and Wang Daolong all monopolized power; their words carried the force of edicts. For a single vacant governorship or magistracy ten appointments might be issued. Court and countryside alike were corrupt, offices were bought with bribes, and the Wang and Ruan families grew richer than the state treasury.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人胡母顥專權，奏無不可。

translations.literal: Hu Muhao, Attendant of the Masters of Writing, monopolized authority; no memorial he submitted was denied.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Muhao, Attendant of the Masters of Writing, held unchecked power; no memorial he submitted was denied.

sentences.zh: 時人語曰：「禾絹閉眼諾，胡母大張橐。

translations.literal: People of the time said: "He Jian closes his eyes and assents; Hu Mu spreads wide his purse.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time said: "He Jian closes his eyes and assents; Hu Mu spreads wide his purse.

sentences.zh: 」「禾絹」謂上也。

translations.literal: " "He Jian" referred to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: " "He Jian" referred to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 及泰始、泰豫之際，左右失旨，往往有刳剒斷截，禁中懍懍若踐刀劍。

translations.literal: During the Taishi and Taiyu periods, when those around him lost favor, there were often flaying, dismemberment, and mutilation; within the forbidden precinct people trembled as if treading on blades.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taishi and Taiyu periods, when those around him lost favor they were often flayed, dismembered, or mutilated; within the forbidden precinct everyone trembled as if walking on blades.

sentences.zh: 夜夢豫章太守劉愔反，遣就郡殺之。

translations.literal: One night he dreamed that Liu Yin, Administrator of Yuzhang, had rebelled, and dispatched men to the commandery to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: One night he dreamed that Liu Yin, Administrator of Yuzhang, had rebelled, and sent men to the commandery to kill him.

sentences.zh: 軍旅不息，府藏空虛，內外百官並斷祿奉。

translations.literal: Campaigns never ceased; the treasury was empty; all officials within and without had their salaries cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigns never ceased, the treasury stood empty, and salaries were cut off for all officials within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 在朝造官者皆市井傭販之子。

translations.literal: Those who purchased office at court were all sons of marketplace laborers and peddlers.
translations.idiomatic: Those who purchased office at court were sons of marketplace laborers and peddlers.

sentences.zh: 而又令小黃門於殿內埋錢以為私藏。

translations.literal: Moreover he ordered junior eunuchs to bury coin within the hall as private hoards.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered junior eunuchs to bury coin inside the palace halls as private hoards.

sentences.zh: 以蜜漬鱁鮧，一食數升，噉臘肉常至二百臠。

translations.literal: He pickled sturgeon in honey and ate several sheng at one sitting; when eating cured meat he commonly consumed as many as two hundred slices.
translations.idiomatic: He pickled sturgeon in honey and ate several sheng at one sitting; when eating cured meat he commonly consumed as many as two hundred slices.

sentences.zh: 奢費過度，每所造制，必為正禦三十，副禦、次副又各三十。

translations.literal: Extravagance exceeded all bounds; for every object he had made, there had to be thirty sets for the principal imperial use, thirty for secondary use, and thirty more for tertiary use.
translations.idiomatic: His extravagance knew no bounds. For every object he ordered made, there had to be thirty sets for principal imperial use, thirty for secondary use, and thirty more for tertiary use.

sentences.zh: 須一物，輒造九十枚。

translations.literal: Needing a single item, he would have ninety pieces made.
translations.idiomatic: Needing a single item, he would have ninety pieces made.

sentences.zh: 天下騷然，民不堪命。

translations.literal: The realm was in turmoil; the people could not bear their burdens.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was in turmoil and the people could not bear their burdens.

sentences.zh: 宋氏之業，自此衰矣。

translations.literal: The enterprise of the Liu Song house from this point declined.
translations.idiomatic: From this point the Liu Song dynasty began its decline.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝諱昱，字德融，明帝長子也。

translations.literal: The Later Deposed Emperor, taboo name Yu, style name Derong, was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Deposed Emperor, taboo name Yu, style name Derong, was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 大明七年正月辛丑，生於衛尉府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Daming, on xinchou in the first month, he was born in the Ministry of Guards residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Daming, on xinchou in the first month, he was born in the Ministry of Guards residence.

sentences.zh: 帝母陳氏，李道兒妾，明帝納之，故人呼帝為李氏子，帝亦自稱李將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor's mother was Lady Chen, a concubine of Li Dao'er whom Emperor Ming took in; therefore people called the emperor the son of the Li family, and the emperor also styled himself General Li.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's mother was Lady Chen, a concubine of Li Dao'er whom Emperor Ming took as consort. People therefore called the emperor the son of the Li family, and he styled himself General Li.

sentences.zh: 明帝諸子在孕，皆以周易筮之，即以所得卦為小字，故帝小字慧震。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming's sons were still in the womb, he divined each with the Zhouyi, and took the resulting hexagram as the childhood name; hence the emperor's childhood name Huizhen.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming's sons were still in the womb, he divined each with the Zhouyi and took the resulting hexagram as the childhood name; hence the emperor's childhood name Huizhen.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taishi he was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taishi he was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 六年，出東宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he left the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he left the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 又制太子元正朝賀，服袞冕九章衣。

translations.literal: It was also decreed that on New Year's Day the crown prince would attend court in audience wearing the nine-symbol robe of imperial investiture.
translations.idiomatic: It was also decreed that on New Year's Day the crown prince would attend court in audience wearing the nine-symbol robe of imperial investiture.

sentences.zh: 明帝崩，庚子，太子即皇帝位，大赦。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming died, on gengzi the crown prince assumed the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming died, on gengzi the crown prince ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 尚書令袁粲、護軍將軍褚彥回共輔朝政，班劍依舊入殿。

translations.literal: Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Chu Yanhui, Colonel Director of the Guard, jointly assisted in governing; they entered the hall bearing ceremonial swords as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Chu Yanhui, Colonel Director of the Guard, jointly governed the realm, entering the hall with ceremonial swords as before.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，尊皇后曰皇太后，立皇后江氏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yisi, the empress was honored as empress dowager and Lady Jiang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi, the empress was honored as empress dowager and Lady Jiang was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，拜帝所生陳貴妃為皇太妃。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuchen, the emperor's birth mother, Honored Consort Chen, was honored as Honored Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuchen, the emperor's birth mother, Honored Consort Chen, was honored as Honored Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己亥，新除郢州刺史劉彥節為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on jihai, Liu Yanjie, newly appointed Inspector of Ying Province, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on jihai, Liu Yanjie, newly appointed Inspector of Ying Province, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 元徽元年春正月戊寅，大赦改元。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Yuanhui, on wuyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first Yuanhui year, on wuyin in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 詔自元年以前徙放者並聽還本。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all those exiled before the first year of the era might return to their native places.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all those exiled before the first year of the era might return home.

sentences.zh: 魏人來聘。

translations.literal: Envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙卯，壽陽大水。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, on yimao, Shouyang suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth month, on yimao, Shouyang suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，立衡陽王嶷子伯玉為南平王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Bo Yu, son of Prince of Hengyang Liao, was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Bo Yu, son of Prince of Hengyang Liao, was established as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on guimao, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, on guimao, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，進桂陽王休范位太尉。

translations.literal: On yisi, Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan was promoted to Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan was promoted to Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，立前建安王世子伯融為始安縣王。

translations.literal: On guihai, Bo Rong, heir of the former Prince of Jian'an, was established as Prince of Shi'an County.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Bo Rong, heir of the former Prince of Jian'an, was established as Prince of Shi'an County.

sentences.zh: 二年夏五月壬午，江州刺史桂陽王休範舉兵反。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month of the second year, on renwu, Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, Governor of Jiang Province, raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month of the second year, on renwu, Prince of Guiyang Xiu Fan, Governor of Jiang Province, rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，內外戒嚴，中領軍劉勉、右衛將軍蕭道成前鋒南討，出屯新亭；

translations.literal: On gengyin, court and camp were placed under martial alert; Liu Mian, Colonel Director of the Interior, and Xiao Daocheng, General of the Right Guard, served as vanguard on the southern campaign and encamped at Xinting;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin martial law was declared within and without the court. Liu Mian, Colonel Director of the Interior, and Xiao Daocheng, General of the Right Guard, led the southern vanguard and encamped at Xinting;

sentences.zh: 征北將軍張永屯白下；

translations.literal: Zhang Yong, General Who Conquers the North, encamped at Baixia;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong, General Who Conquers the North, encamped at Baixia;

sentences.zh: 前南兗州刺史沈懷明戍石頭；

translations.literal: Shen Huaiming, former Inspector of Southern Yan Province, garrisoned Shitou;
translations.idiomatic: Shen Huaiming, former Inspector of Southern Yan Province, garrisoned Shitou;

sentences.zh: 衛將軍袁粲、中軍將軍褚彥回入衛殿省。

translations.literal: Yuan Can, General of the Guard, and Chu Yanhui, General of the Central Army, entered to guard the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Can, General of the Guard, and Chu Yanhui, General of the Central Army, entered the palace to guard the inner offices.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賊奄至，攻新亭壘，道成拒擊，大破之。

translations.literal: On renchen the rebels suddenly arrived and attacked the fort at Xinting; Daocheng repelled and struck them and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the rebels suddenly arrived and attacked the fort at Xinting. Daocheng repelled them and won a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 越騎校尉張苟兒斬休范，賊党杜黑蠡、丁文豪分軍向朱雀航，劉勉拒賊，敗績，死之。

translations.literal: Zhang Gou'er, Colonel of Agile Cavalry, beheaded Xiu Fan; the rebel partisans Du Heili and Ding Wenhao divided their forces toward the Zhuque Floating Bridge; Liu Mian resisted the rebels, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gou'er, Colonel of Agile Cavalry, beheaded Xiu Fan. Rebel partisans Du Heili and Ding Wenhao split their forces toward the Zhuque Floating Bridge. Liu Mian resisted the rebels, was defeated, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 右將軍王道隆奔走，遇害。

translations.literal: Wang Daolong, General of the Right, fled in panic and met with disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Daolong, General of the Right, fled in panic and was killed.

sentences.zh: 張永潰于白下，沈懷明自石頭奔散。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong broke at Baixia; Shen Huaiming fled in disarray from Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong's line broke at Baixia; Shen Huaiming fled in disarray from Shitou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，車騎典簽茅恬開東府納賊，賊入屯中堂，羽林監陳顯達擊，大破之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Mao Tian, Chief Clerk of the Chariots and Cavalry Office, opened the Eastern Palace and admitted the rebels; the rebels entered and encamped in the Central Hall, and Chen Xianda, Director of the Feathered Forest Guard, attacked and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Mao Tian, Chief Clerk of the Chariots and Cavalry Office, opened the Eastern Palace and admitted the rebels. The rebels entered and encamped in the Central Hall, but Chen Xianda, Director of the Feathered Forest Guard, attacked and routed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，張苟兒等又破賊，進平東府城，梟禽群賊。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhang Gou'er and others again defeated the rebels, advanced and pacified the Eastern Palace city, and captured the rebel ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Gou'er and others defeated the rebels again, advanced to pacify the Eastern Palace city, and captured the rebel ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大赦，解嚴。

translations.literal: On dingyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed and martial alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou a general amnesty was proclaimed and martial alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 荊州刺史沈攸之、南徐州刺史建平王景素、郢州刺史晉熙王燮、湘州刺史王僧虔、雍州刺史張興世並舉義兵赴建鄴。

translations.literal: Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province; Prince of Jianping Jing Su; Prince of Jinxi Xie, Inspector of Ying Province; Wang Sengqian, Inspector of Xiang Province; and Zhang Xingshi, Inspector of Yong Province, all raised righteous armies and hastened to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province; Prince of Jianping Jing Su; Prince of Jinxi Xie, Inspector of Ying Province; Wang Sengqian, Inspector of Xiang Province; and Zhang Xingshi, Inspector of Yong Province, all raised loyal armies and marched to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，晉熙王燮遣軍克尋陽，江州平。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guimao, Prince of Jinxi Xie dispatched troops and captured Xunyang; Jiang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, Prince of Jinxi Xie dispatched troops and captured Xunyang, pacifying Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔師將軍還為輔國。

translations.literal: On renxu, the title General Who Assists the Army was changed back to General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the title General Who Assists the Army was changed back to General Who Assists the State.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，立皇弟友為邵陵王。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengchen, the emperor's younger brother You was established as Prince of Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengchen, the emperor's younger brother You was established as Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，南徐州刺史建平王景素進號征北將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Prince of Jianping Jing Su, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was promoted to General Who Conquers the North with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Prince of Jianping Jing Su, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was promoted to General Who Conquers the North with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，以袁粲為中書監，領司徒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingyou, Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing and concurrently Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and concurrently Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 加護軍將軍褚彥回為尚書令。

translations.literal: Chu Yanhui, Colonel Director of the Guard, was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Yanhui, Colonel Director of the Guard, was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙戌，帝加元服。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on bingxu, the emperor received the cap of manhood.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on bingxu, the emperor received the cap of manhood.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，立皇弟躋為江夏王，贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guihai, the emperor's younger brothers Ji and Zan were established as Prince of Jiangxia and Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai, the emperor's younger brothers Ji and Zan were established as Prince of Jiangxia and Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月己巳，都下大水。

translations.literal: In spring, the third month of the third year, on jisi, the capital suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the third month of the third year, on jisi, the capital suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth month, envoys from Northern Wei came on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，以袁粲為尚書令。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengxu, Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengxu, Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，征西大將軍河南王吐谷渾拾寅進號車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Tuyuhun Shiyin, General Who Conquers the West and Prince of Henan, was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Tuyuhun Shiyin, General Who Conquers the West and Prince of Henan, was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 四年夏六月乙亥，加蕭道成尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month of the fourth year, on yihai, Xiao Daocheng was promoted to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth month of the fourth year, on yihai, Xiao Daocheng was promoted to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，建平王景素據京城反。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuzi, Prince of Jianping Jing Su seized the capital city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuzi, Prince of Jianping Jing Su seized the capital city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 己丑，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On jichou, court and camp were placed under strict martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou strict martial alert was declared within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 遣驍騎將軍任農夫、冠軍將軍黃回北討，蕭道成總統眾軍。

translations.literal: The General of Agile Cavalry Ren Nongfu and the General Who Establishes the Campaign Huang Hui were dispatched on the northern campaign; Xiao Daocheng was made overall commander of the mass of armies.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Nongfu, General of Agile Cavalry, and Huang Hui, General Who Establishes the Campaign, were dispatched north; Xiao Daocheng was made overall commander of the main armies.

sentences.zh: 始安王伯融、都鄉侯伯猷並賜死。

translations.literal: Prince of Shi'an Bo Rong and District Marquis Bo You were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shi'an Bo Rong and District Marquis Bo You were both put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙未，克京城，斬景素，同逆皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On yimwei, the capital city was taken; Jing Su was beheaded, and all who had rebelled with him were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimwei the capital city was taken, Jing Su was beheaded, and all who had rebelled with him were executed.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，立皇弟翽為南陽王，嵩為新興王，禧為始建王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingmao, the emperor's younger brothers Hui, Song, and Xi were established as Prince of Nanyang, Prince of Xinxing, and Prince of Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingmao, the emperor's younger brothers Hui, Song, and Xi were established as Prince of Nanyang, Prince of Xinxing, and Prince of Shijian.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，驍騎將軍高道慶有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi, Gao Daoqing, General of Agile Cavalry, was guilty of a crime and granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, Gao Daoqing, General of Agile Cavalry, was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 己丑，車騎將軍、

translations.literal: On jichou, the General of Chariots and Cavalry,
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the General of Chariots and Cavalry,

sentences.zh: 揚州刺史安成王准進號驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Prince of Ancheng Zhun, Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ancheng Zhun, Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，以王僧虔為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinyou, Wang Sengqian was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on xinyou, Wang Sengqian was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 五年夏四月甲戌，豫州刺史阮佃夫、步兵校尉申伯宗、朱幼謀廢立，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month of the fifth year, on jiaxu, Ruan Tianfu, Inspector of Yu Province, Shen Bozong, Colonel of the Footsoldiers, and Zhu You plotted to depose and install a ruler; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month of the fifth year, on jiaxu, Ruan Tianfu, Inspector of Yu Province, Shen Bozong, Colonel of the Footsoldiers, and Zhu You plotted to depose the emperor and install another; all were executed.

sentences.zh: 五月，地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，誅司徒左長史沈勃、散騎常侍杜幼文、遊擊將軍孫超之、長水校尉杜叔文。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Shen Bo, Left Chief Administrator of the Minister of Works; Du Youwen, Regular Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant; Sun Chaozhi, General Who Roams in Attack; and Du Shuwen, Colonel of the Chang River, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Shen Bo, Left Chief Administrator of the Minister of Works; Du Youwen, Regular Attendant of the Cavalier Attendant; Sun Chaozhi, General Who Roams in Attack; and Du Shuwen, Colonel of the Chang River, were executed.

sentences.zh: 七月戊子夜，帝遇弑于仁壽殿，時年十五。

translations.literal: On the night of wuzi in the seventh month, the emperor was assassinated in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity, aged fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuzi in the seventh month, the emperor was assassinated in the Hall of Benevolent Longevity, aged fifteen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇太后令貶帝為蒼梧郡王，葬丹陽秣陵縣郊壇西。

translations.literal: On jichou, the empress dowager issued an order degrading the emperor to Prince of Cangwu Commandery; he was buried west of the suburban altar in Moling County, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the empress dowager issued an order degrading him to Prince of Cangwu Commandery. He was buried west of the suburban altar in Moling County, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 初帝之生夕，明帝夢人乘馬，馬無頭及後足，有人曰：「太子也。

translations.literal: When the emperor was born at dusk, Emperor Ming dreamed of a man riding a horse; the horse had neither head nor hind legs, and someone said: "The crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of the emperor's birth, Emperor Ming dreamed of a man riding a horse with neither head nor hind legs, and someone said, "The crown prince.

sentences.zh: 」及在東宮，五六歲能緣漆帳竿，去地丈餘，如此者半食久乃下。

translations.literal: " While in the Eastern Palace, at five or six years of age he could climb lacquered bed-curtain poles more than a zhang above the ground; he would remain so for half a meal's time before coming down.
translations.idiomatic: " While in the Eastern Palace, at five or six he could climb lacquered bed-curtain poles more than a zhang above the ground and remain there for half a meal before coming down.

sentences.zh: 漸長，喜怒乖節，左右失旨者手加撲打，徒跣蹲踞。

translations.literal: As he gradually grew, joy and anger lost all measure; those around him who missed his intent he would beat with his own hands, going barefoot and squatting on his heels.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew, his moods swung beyond all measure. Those who displeased him he beat with his own hands, going barefoot and squatting on his heels.

sentences.zh: 及嗣位，內畏太后，外憚大臣，猶未得肆志。

translations.literal: When he succeeded to the throne, inwardly he feared the empress dowager and outwardly dreaded the great ministers, and still could not fully indulge his will.
translations.idiomatic: When he succeeded to the throne he still feared the empress dowager within and the great ministers without, and could not yet fully indulge his will.

sentences.zh: 自加元服，三年，好出入，單將左右，或十里、二十里，或入市里，遇慢罵則悅而受焉。

translations.literal: From receiving the cap of manhood through three years, he loved going out, taking only his personal attendants; sometimes ten or twenty li, sometimes entering market wards—if he met with insults he would be pleased and accept them.
translations.idiomatic: From his coming of age through three years he loved going abroad with only his personal attendants—sometimes ten or twenty li, sometimes into the market wards—and if he met with insults he would be pleased and accept them.

sentences.zh: 四年，無日不出，與左右解僧智、張五兒恒夜出開承明門，夕去晨反，晨出暮歸，從者並執鋌矛，行人男女及犬馬牛驢逢無免者。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, not a day passed without his going out. With his attendants Jie Sengzhi and Zhang Wu'er he constantly went out at night through the Gate of Illuminated Governance, leaving at evening and returning at dawn, or leaving at dawn and returning at evening; his followers all carried spears and halberds, and men and women, dogs, horses, oxen, and donkeys they encountered were none spared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he went out every day without exception. With his attendants Jie Sengzhi and Zhang Wu'er he constantly slipped out at night through the Gate of Illuminated Governance, leaving at evening and returning at dawn—or the reverse. His followers all carried spears and halberds, and no man or woman, dog, horse, ox, or donkey they met was spared.

sentences.zh: 人間擾懼，晝日不開門，道無行人。

translations.literal: Among the people there was alarm and fear; in broad daylight doors were not opened, and the roads had no travelers.
translations.idiomatic: The people lived in alarm and fear. In broad daylight doors stayed shut and the roads were empty.

sentences.zh: 嘗著小褲，不服衣冠。

translations.literal: He would sometimes wear short trousers and would not put on cap and robes.
translations.idiomatic: He sometimes wore short trousers and refused cap and formal robes.

sentences.zh: 有白棓數十，各有名號，鉗鑿錐鋸，不離左右，為擊腦、槌陰、剖心之誅，日有數十。

translations.literal: He had several dozen white clubs, each with its own name; pincers, chisels, awls, and saws never left his side, and punishments of smashing the skull, crushing the groin, and disemboweling the heart numbered several tens each day.
translations.idiomatic: He kept several dozen white clubs, each with its own name. Pincers, chisels, awls, and saws never left his side, and punishments of smashing skulls, crushing groins, and disemboweling hearts numbered several tens each day.

sentences.zh: 常見臥屍流血，然後為樂。

translations.literal: He constantly had to see corpses lying in blood before he could feel joy.
translations.idiomatic: He had to see corpses lying in blood before he could feel joy.

sentences.zh: 左右人見有嚬眉者，帝令其正立，以矛刺洞之。

translations.literal: If those around him were seen to knit their brows, the emperor ordered them to stand upright and ran them through with a spear.
translations.idiomatic: If anyone around him was seen to knit his brows, the emperor ordered him to stand upright and ran him through with a spear.

sentences.zh: 曜靈殿上養驢數十頭，所自乘馬，養於御床側。

translations.literal: In the Hall of Radiant Spirit he kept several dozen donkeys; the horse he himself rode was kept beside the imperial couch.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hall of Radiant Spirit he kept several dozen donkeys, and the horse he rode was stabled beside the imperial couch.

sentences.zh: 與右衛翼輦營女子私通，每從之遊，持數千錢為酒肉之費。

translations.literal: He privately consorted with women of the Right Guard Winged-Litter Guard and constantly went about with them, carrying several thousand coins for wine and meat.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly consorted with women of the Right Guard Winged-Litter Guard, constantly roaming with them and carrying several thousand coins for wine and meat.

sentences.zh: 出逢婚姻葬送，輒與挽車小兒群聚飲酒，以為歡適。

translations.literal: Going out he would encounter weddings and funerals, and would join the cart-pulling boys in drinking together, taking it as pleasant diversion.
translations.idiomatic: Going abroad he would encounter weddings and funerals and join the cart-pulling boys in drinking, taking it as pleasant diversion.

sentences.zh: 阮佃夫腹心人張羊為佃夫委信，佃夫敗，叛走，復捕得，自於承明門以車轢殺之。

translations.literal: Zhang Yang, a confidant of Ruan Tianfu whom Tianfu deeply trusted, fled when Tianfu fell, was captured again, and the emperor personally had him crushed to death by cart wheels at the Gate of Illuminated Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yang, a confidant deeply trusted by Ruan Tianfu, fled when Tianfu fell, was captured again, and the emperor personally had him crushed to death by cart wheels at the Gate of Illuminated Governance.

sentences.zh: 殺杜延載、杜幼文，躬運矛鋌，手自臠割。

translations.literal: He killed Du Yanzai and Du Youwen, wielding spear and halberd himself and cutting the flesh with his own hands.
translations.idiomatic: He killed Du Yanzai and Du Youwen, wielding spear and halberd himself and cutting their flesh with his own hands.

sentences.zh: 察孫超有蒜氣，剖腹視之。

translations.literal: Detecting garlic on Sun Chao's breath, he opened his belly to look.
translations.idiomatic: Detecting garlic on Sun Chao's breath, he opened his belly to look inside.

sentences.zh: 執楯馳馬，自往刺杜叔文于玄武北湖。

translations.literal: Gripping a shield and galloping on horseback, he went in person to stab Du Shuwen at the Northern Lake of Xuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: Gripping a shield and galloping on horseback, he went in person to stab Du Shuwen at the Northern Lake of Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝二十八子，明帝殺其十六，餘皆帝殺之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu had twenty-eight sons; Emperor Ming killed sixteen of them, and the rest were all killed by this emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu had twenty-eight sons. Emperor Ming killed sixteen of them, and this emperor killed the rest.

sentences.zh: 吳興沈勃多寶貨，往劫之，揮刀獨前，左右未至，勃時居喪在廬，帝望見之，便投鋌，不中；

translations.literal: Shen Bo of Wuxing possessed many treasures; the emperor went to rob him, swinging a blade and going ahead alone before his attendants arrived. Bo was then in mourning and living in a hut; the emperor saw him from afar and hurled a halberd, but missed;
translations.idiomatic: Shen Bo of Wuxing possessed many treasures. The emperor went to rob him, swinging a blade and charging ahead alone before his attendants arrived. Bo was then in mourning and living in a hut. The emperor saw him from afar and hurled a halberd but missed.

sentences.zh: 勃知不免，手搏帝耳，唾駡之曰：「汝罪踰桀、紂，屠戮無日！

translations.literal: Bo knew he could not escape, grappled the emperor by the ear with his hand, spat and cursed him, saying: "Your crimes exceed those of Jie and Zhou—your slaughter will not last a day!
translations.idiomatic: Bo knew he could not escape, seized the emperor by the ear, spat, and cursed him: "Your crimes exceed those of Jie and Zhou—your day of slaughter will come soon!

sentences.zh: 」遂見害，帝自臠割。

translations.literal: " He was then killed; the emperor cut the flesh himself.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then killed, and the emperor cut the flesh himself.

sentences.zh: 制露車一乘，施莑，乘以出入，從數十人，羽儀追之，恒不相及；

translations.literal: He had an open carriage made with a thatched canopy and rode it in going out and coming in, followed by several tens of men; the ceremonial guard pursued but constantly could not catch up;
translations.idiomatic: He had an open carriage made with a thatched canopy and rode it in going out and coming in, followed by several tens of men. The ceremonial guard pursued but could never catch up.

sentences.zh: 又各慮禍，亦不敢追，但整部伍，別在一處瞻望而已。
