translations.literal: each also feared disaster and dared not pursue, but only kept ranks in order and watched from another place.
translations.idiomatic: Each also feared for his life and dared not pursue, but only kept ranks in order and watched from afar.

sentences.zh: 凡諸鄙事，過目則能，鍛銀、裁衣、作帽，莫不精絕。

translations.literal: In all vulgar crafts, whatever he saw he could do; forging silver, cutting cloth, and making caps—none was not perfected to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: In every vulgar craft, whatever he saw he could do. Forging silver, cutting cloth, making caps—none was not perfected to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 未嘗吹箎，執管便韻。

translations.literal: He had never blown the chi, yet taking the pipe he produced melody at once.
translations.idiomatic: He had never blown the chi, yet taking up the pipe he produced melody at once.

sentences.zh: 天性好殺，一日無事，輒慘慘不樂。

translations.literal: By nature he loved killing; if a day passed without an affair, he would be gloomy and unhappy.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he loved killing. If a day passed without bloodshed he would be gloomy and unhappy.

sentences.zh: 內外憂惶，夕不及旦。

translations.literal: Within and without, anxiety and dread—night did not reach dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without the court, anxiety and dread were such that night did not reach dawn.

sentences.zh: 領軍將軍蕭道成與直合將軍王敬則謀之。

translations.literal: Xiao Daocheng, Colonel Director of the Army, and Wang Jingze, Direct Attendant General, plotted against him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng, Colonel Director of the Army, and Wang Jingze, Direct Attendant General, plotted against him.

sentences.zh: 七月戊子，帝微行出北湖，單馬先走，羽儀不及，左右張五兒馬墜湖，帝怒，自馳騎刺馬，屠割之。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the seventh month, the emperor went out incognito to the Northern Lake, riding a single horse and galloping ahead while the ceremonial guard could not keep up; Zhang Wu'er's horse fell into the lake, and the emperor in anger galloped back himself, stabbed the horse, and butchered it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the seventh month the emperor went out incognito to the Northern Lake, riding a single horse and galloping ahead while the ceremonial guard could not keep up. Zhang Wu'er's horse fell into the lake. The emperor in rage galloped back, stabbed the horse, and butchered it.

sentences.zh: 與左右作羌胡伎為樂。

translations.literal: With his attendants he performed Qiang and Hu entertainments for amusement.
translations.idiomatic: With his attendants he performed Qiang and Hu entertainments for amusement.

sentences.zh: 又於蠻岡賭跳，因乘露車，無復鹵簿，往青園尼寺。

translations.literal: He also gambled at leaping on Mang Hill, then rode the open carriage without any guard of honor and went to the Qing Garden Nunnery.
translations.idiomatic: He also gambled at leaping on Mang Hill, then rode the open carriage without guard of honor to the Qing Garden Nunnery.

sentences.zh: 晚至新安寺偷狗，就曇度道人煮之飲酒。

translations.literal: Late at night he reached Xin'an Temple, stole a dog, and with the monk Tandu cooked it and drank wine.
translations.idiomatic: Late at night he reached Xin'an Temple, stole a dog, and with the monk Tandu cooked it and drank wine.

sentences.zh: 楊玉夫常得意，忽然見憎，遇輒切齒，曰：「明日當殺小子，取肝肺。

translations.literal: Yang Yufu was often in favor, then suddenly was hated; whenever he met him he would grind his teeth and say: "Tomorrow I shall kill the boy and take his liver and lungs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yufu was often in favor, then suddenly fell from grace. Whenever he met him the emperor would grind his teeth and say, "Tomorrow I shall kill the boy and take his liver and lungs.

sentences.zh: 」是夜七夕，令玉夫伺織女度，報己，因與內人穿針訖，大醉，臥于仁壽殿東阿氈幄中。

translations.literal: " That night was the Qixi Festival; he ordered Yufu to watch for the Weaving Maid's crossing and report when ready; then with the palace women he finished threading the needle, drank heavily, and slept in the eastern felt tent of the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: " That night was the Qixi Festival. He ordered Yufu to watch for the Weaving Maid's crossing and report when ready. Then with the palace women he finished threading the needle, drank heavily, and slept in the eastern felt tent of the Hall of Benevolent Longevity.

sentences.zh: 帝出入無禁，王敬則先結玉夫、陳奉伯、楊萬年等合二十五人，其夕玉夫候帝眠熟，至乙夜，與萬年同入氈幄內，取千牛刀殺之。

translations.literal: The emperor went in and out without restriction. Wang Jingze had first joined with Yufu, Chen Fengbo, Yang Wannian, and twenty-three others in all. That evening Yufu waited until the emperor slept soundly; at the second watch of the night he entered the felt tent with Wannian, took the office halberd-knife, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came and went without restriction. Wang Jingze had first joined with Yufu, Chen Fengbo, Yang Wannian, and twenty-three others in all. That evening Yufu waited until the emperor slept soundly. At the second watch he entered the felt tent with Wannian, took the office halberd-knife, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 順皇帝，諱准，字仲謨，小字知觀，明帝第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, style name Zhongmo, childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shun, taboo name Zhun, style name Zhongmo, childhood name Zhiguan, was the third son of Emperor Ming.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年七月癸丑生。

translations.literal: He was born on guichou in the seventh month of the fifth year of Taishi.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on guichou in the seventh month of the fifth year of Taishi.

sentences.zh: 七年，封安成王。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 帝姿貌端華，眉目如畫，見者以為神人。

translations.literal: The emperor's bearing was dignified and splendid; his eyebrows and eyes were like a painting; those who saw him took him for a spirit man.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's bearing was dignified and splendid, his eyebrows and eyes like a painting. Those who saw him took him for a spirit made flesh.

sentences.zh: 廢帝即位，加揚州刺史。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor ascended the throne, he was additionally made Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor ascended the throne, he was additionally appointed Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 元徽二年，加都督揚、南豫二州諸軍事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanhui he was additionally made overall commander of all military affairs in Yang and Southern Yu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanhui he was additionally made overall commander of all military affairs in Yang and Southern Yu provinces.

sentences.zh: 四年，進號驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 及廢帝殞，蕭道成奉太后令迎王入居朝堂。

translations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor died, Xiao Daocheng, following the empress dowager's order, welcomed the prince to enter and dwell in the Court Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor died, Xiao Daocheng, following the empress dowager's order, welcomed the prince to enter and dwell in the Court Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，司徒袁粲鎮石頭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai, Yuan Can, Minister of Works, garrisoned Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, Yuan Can, Minister of Works, garrisoned Shitou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，崇拜帝所生陳昭華為皇太妃。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the emperor's birth mother Chen Zhaohua was honored as Honored Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor's birth mother Chen Zhaohua was honored as Honored Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以蕭道成為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，錄尚書如故。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xiao Daocheng was made General of Agile Cavalry with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, continuing as Recorder of the Masters of Writing as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xiao Daocheng was appointed General of Agile Cavalry with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, continuing as Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，廬陵王暠薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Prince of Luling Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Prince of Luling Hao died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，荊州刺史沈攸之舉兵，不從執政。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province, raised troops and would not obey the regents.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Shen Youzhi, Inspector of Jing Province, raised troops and refused to obey the regents.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蕭道成入守朝堂，侍中蕭嶷鎮東府。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Xiao Daocheng entered to guard the Court Hall; Xiao Luan, Palace Attendant, garrisoned the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xiao Daocheng entered to guard the Court Hall; Xiao Luan, Palace Attendant, garrisoned the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，中外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On wuchen, court and camp were placed under strict martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen strict martial alert was declared within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 壬申，司徒袁粲據石頭，謀誅道成，不果，旋見覆滅。

translations.literal: On renshen, Yuan Can, Minister of Works, held Shitou and plotted to execute Daocheng, but did not succeed and was soon overthrown and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yuan Can, Minister of Works, held Shitou and plotted to execute Daocheng, but failed and was soon overthrown and destroyed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以王僧虔為左僕射，王延之為右僕射。

translations.literal: On yihai, Wang Sengqian was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Wang Yanzhi Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wang Sengqian was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Wang Yanzhi Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守劉遐據郡不從執政，令張瑰攻斬之。

translations.literal: Liu Xia, Administrator of Wu Commandery, held the commandery and would not obey the regents; Zhang Gui was ordered to attack and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xia, Administrator of Wu Commandery, held the commandery and refused to obey the regents. Zhang Gui was ordered to attack and behead him.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，屯騎校尉王宜興貳於執政，見誅。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinsi, Wang Yixing, Colonel of the Resolute Cavalry, turned against the regents and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinsi, Wang Yixing, Colonel of the Resolute Cavalry, turned against the regents and was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，沈攸之攻郢城，前軍長史柳世隆固守。

translations.literal: On guisi, Shen Youzhi attacked Ying city; Liu Shilong, Chief Administrator of the vanguard, held firm in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Shen Youzhi attacked Ying city; Liu Shilong, Chief Administrator of the vanguard, held firm in defense.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中外戒嚴，假蕭道成黃鉞。

translations.literal: On jihai, court and camp were placed under martial alert, and Xiao Daocheng was given the yellow battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai martial alert was declared within and without the court, and Xiao Daocheng was given the yellow battle-axe.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，道成出頓新亭。

translations.literal: On yisi, Daocheng went out and encamped at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Daocheng went out and encamped at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏太和元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Northern Wei's Taihe era.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of the Northern Wei Taihe era.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯，沈攸之敗，己巳，華容縣人斬攸之首送之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on dingmao, Shen Youzhi was defeated; on jisi a man of Huarong County beheaded Youzhi and sent his head.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the second year, on dingmao, Shen Youzhi was defeated. On jisi a man of Huarong County beheaded Youzhi and sent his head.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史張敬兒克江陵，荊州平。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhang Jing'er, Inspector of Yong Province, captured Jiangling and Jing Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zhang Jing'er, Inspector of Yong Province, captured Jiangling and pacified Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 丙子，解嚴。

translations.literal: On bingzi, martial alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi martial alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 以柳世隆為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Liu Shilong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shilong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成旋鎮東府。

translations.literal: Xiao Daocheng then returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng then returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，以王僧虔為尚書令，王延之為左僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengchen, Wang Sengqian was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Wang Yanzhi Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, Wang Sengqian was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and Wang Yanzhi Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蕭道成加授太尉，以褚彥回為中書監、司空。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Xiao Daocheng was additionally invested as Grand Commandant; Chu Yanhui was made Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xiao Daocheng was additionally invested as Grand Commandant; Chu Yanhui was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing and Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，撫軍將軍、揚州刺史晉熙王燮進號中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince of Jinxi Xie, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Prince of Jinxi Xie, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yang Province, was promoted to General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiyou, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiyou, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，南兗州刺史黃回貳於執政，賜死。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Huang Hui, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, turned against the regents and was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Huang Hui, Inspector of Southern Yan Province, turned against the regents and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，以倭國王武為安東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuwu, Wu, King of Wa, was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu, Wu, King of Wa, was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以輔國將軍楊文弘為北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Yang Wenhong, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Yang Wenhong, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Inspector of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on yisi, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the ninth month, on yisi, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加太尉蕭道成黃鉞、都督中外諸軍事、太傅，領揚州牧，賜殊禮。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Grand Commandant Xiao Daocheng was given the yellow battle-axe, made overall commander of all military affairs within and without, Grand Tutor, and concurrently Governor of Yang Province, with extraordinary honors.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Grand Commandant Xiao Daocheng was given the yellow battle-axe, made overall commander of all military affairs within and without, Grand Tutor, and concurrently Governor of Yang Province, with extraordinary honors.

sentences.zh: 以揚州刺史晉熙王燮為司徒。

translations.literal: Prince of Jinxi Xie, Governor of Yang Province, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jinxi Xie, Governor of Yang Province, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，立皇后謝氏。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renyin, Lady Xie was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on renyin, Lady Xie was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立故武昌太守劉琨息頒為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Ban, son of the former Administrator of Wuchang Liu Kun, was established as Prince of Nanfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Ban, son of the former Administrator of Wuchang Liu Kun, was established as Prince of Nanfeng County.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，誅臨澧侯劉晃。

translations.literal: On guihai, Marquis of Linli Liu Huang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Marquis of Linli Liu Huang was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改封南陽王翽為隨郡王。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Prince of Nanyang Hui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince of Nanyang Hui was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，皇后見於太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, the empress was presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, the empress was presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛亥，領軍將軍蕭賾加尚書右僕射，進號中軍大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on xinhai, Xiao Ze, Colonel Director of the Army, was additionally made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and promoted to General of the Central Army with privilege of an imperial establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of the third year, on xinhai, Xiao Ze, Colonel Director of the Army, was additionally appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and promoted to General of the Central Army with privilege of an establishment equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，南豫州刺史邵陵王友薨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingzi, Prince of Shaoling You, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingzi, Prince of Shaoling You, Inspector of Southern Yu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，地震建陽門。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an earthquake struck the Jianyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an earthquake struck the Jianyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao, the first day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, the first day, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，加蕭道成相國，總百揆，封十郡為齊公，備九錫之禮。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xiao Daocheng was additionally made Chancellor, with overall charge of all affairs; ten commanderies were enfeoffed to him as Duke of Qi, with the full honors of the Nine Bestowals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xiao Daocheng was additionally made Chancellor with overall charge of all affairs. Ten commanderies were enfeoffed to him as Duke of Qi with the full honors of the Nine Bestowals.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，誅臨川王綽。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Prince of Linchuan Chuo was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Prince of Linchuan Chuo was executed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，進齊公蕭道成爵為王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renshen, Duke of Qi Xiao Daocheng was promoted in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renshen, Duke of Qi Xiao Daocheng was promoted in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 壬午，安西將軍武陵王贊薨。

translations.literal: On renwu, Prince of Wuling Zan, General Who Pacifies the West, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Prince of Wuling Zan, General Who Pacifies the West, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝禪位於齊。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the emperor abdicated the throne to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor abdicated the throne to Qi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遜于東邸。

translations.literal: On renchen, he retired to the Eastern Residence.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he retired to the Eastern Residence.

sentences.zh: 是日，王敬則以兵陳於殿庭，帝猶居內，聞之，逃于佛蓋下。

translations.literal: That day, Wang Jingze arrayed troops in the palace courtyard; the emperor was still inside, heard it, and fled beneath the Buddha canopy.
translations.idiomatic: That day Wang Jingze arrayed troops in the palace courtyard. The emperor was still inside, heard it, and fled beneath the Buddha canopy.

sentences.zh: 太后懼，自帥閹豎索，扶幸板輿。

translations.literal: The empress dowager in fear led the eunuchs herself in searching, and supported him into the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager in fear led the eunuchs herself in searching and supported him into the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 黃門或促之，帝怒，抽刀投之，中項而殞。

translations.literal: A gate attendant urged haste; the emperor in anger drew a knife and threw it, striking him in the neck and killing him.
translations.idiomatic: A gate attendant urged haste. The emperor in anger drew a knife and threw it, striking him in the neck and killing him.

sentences.zh: 帝既出，宮人行哭，俱遷。

translations.literal: Once the emperor had gone out, the palace women walked along weeping; all were relocated.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor had gone out, the palace women walked along weeping. All were relocated.

sentences.zh: 備羽儀，乘畫輪車，出東掖門。

translations.literal: With full guard of honor he rode the painted wheel carriage and went out through the Eastern Side Gate.
translations.idiomatic: With full guard of honor he rode the painted wheel carriage and went out through the Eastern Side Gate.

sentences.zh: 封帝為汝陰王，居丹徒宮，齊兵衛之。

translations.literal: The emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan and dwelt at the Dantu palace, guarded by Qi troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enfeoffed as Prince of Runan and dwelt at the Dantu palace, guarded by Qi troops.

sentences.zh: 建元元年五月己未，帝聞外有馳馬者，懼亂作；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jianyuan, on jiwei, the emperor heard horsemen riding outside and feared disorder;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first Jianyuan year, on jiwei, the emperor heard horsemen riding outside and feared disorder.

sentences.zh: 監人殺王而以疾赴，齊人德之，賞之以邑。

translations.literal: the guard killed the prince and reported illness; the men of Qi were grateful and rewarded him with an estate.
translations.idiomatic: The guard killed the prince and reported illness. The men of Qi were grateful and rewarded him with an estate.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，葬于遂寧陵，諡曰順帝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, he was buried at Suining Mausoleum with posthumous title Emperor Shun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou, he was buried at Suining Mausoleum with posthumous title Emperor Shun.

sentences.zh: 宋之王侯無少長皆幽死矣。

translations.literal: All the princes and marquises of Song, young and old alike, died in confinement.
translations.idiomatic: All the princes and marquises of Song, young and old alike, died in confinement.

sentences.zh: 論曰：文帝負扆南面，實有人君之美，經國之義雖弘，而隆家之道不足。

translations.literal: The judgment says: Emperor Wen, bearing the imperial screen and facing south, truly possessed the beauty of a ruler; though the principles of governing the state were broad, the way of elevating the family was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: The judgment says: Emperor Wen, bearing the imperial screen and facing south, truly possessed the qualities of a ruler. Though his principles of statecraft were broad, his way of strengthening the house was insufficient.

sentences.zh: 彭城照不窺古，本無卓爾之資，徒見昆弟之義深，未識君臣之禮異。

translations.literal: Prince of Pengcheng Zhao did not look into antiquity and originally lacked outstanding talent; he saw only the depth of brotherly affection and did not recognize that the rites between ruler and minister differ.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Zhao did not look to antiquity and lacked outstanding talent of his own. He saw only the depth of brotherly affection and did not recognize that the rites between ruler and minister differ.

sentences.zh: 以此家情，行之國道，主忌而猶犯，恩離而未悟。

translations.literal: Taking this family sentiment and applying it to the way of the state, the lord grew suspicious yet they still transgressed; favor was severed yet they still did not awaken.
translations.idiomatic: Taking this family sentiment and applying it to affairs of state, the sovereign grew suspicious yet they still transgressed; favor was severed yet they still did not awaken.

sentences.zh: 致以陵逼之愆，遂成滅親之禍。

translations.literal: Thus leading to the fault of pressing upon the sovereign, they thereby brought about the calamity of destroying kin.
translations.idiomatic: Thus leading to the fault of pressing upon the sovereign, they brought about the calamity of destroying their own kin.

sentences.zh: 開端樹隙，垂之後人。

translations.literal: Opening the beginning and planting the rift, they bequeathed it to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: They opened the breach and planted the rift, bequeathing it to later generations.

sentences.zh: 明帝因猜忍之情，據已行之典，翦落洪枝，願不待慮。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming, relying on suspicious and cruel sentiment and taking precedent from what had already been done, cut down the great branches without waiting for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming, relying on suspicious and cruel sentiment and taking precedent from what had already been done, cut down the great branches of the royal house without waiting for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 既而本根莫庇，幼主孤立，下無磐石之托，上有累卵之危。

translations.literal: Thereafter the root had no shelter; the young sovereign stood alone; below there was no support like a bedrock, and above there was danger like a pile of eggs.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the root had no shelter and the young sovereign stood alone. Below there was no bedrock to support him; above there was danger like a pile of eggs.

sentences.zh: 方復藏璽懷紱，魚服忘反，危冠短制，匹馬孤征，以至覆亡，理固然矣。

translations.literal: Yet again he hid the seal and clasped the cord, forgetting that a fish in official robes invites disaster; he wore the tall cap and short coat and went alone on a single horse on a solitary journey, until ruin came—reason assuredly made it so.
translations.idiomatic: Yet again he hid the seal and clasped the cord, forgetting that a fish in official robes invites disaster; he wore the tall cap and short coat and rode alone on a solitary journey until ruin came—as reason assuredly dictated.

sentences.zh: 神器以勢弱傾移，靈命隨樂推回改。

translations.literal: The sacred vessel shifted because power was weak; the mandate of spirit turned and changed with the tide of popular acclaim.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred vessel shifted because power had grown weak; the mandate turned and changed with the tide of popular acclaim.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋履霜有漸，夫豈一夕，何止區區汝陰揖讓而已。

translations.literal: This was surely like frost forming by gradual steps—not in a single night—and far more than the mere yielding of Runan.
translations.idiomatic: This was surely like frost forming by gradual steps—not in a single night—and far more than the mere abdication of the Prince of Runan.
